items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves functoriality of derived tensor in the bimodule and that quasi-isomorphisms of bimodules induce isomorphisms of functors (statement lines 5558-5568). The proof (lines 5570-5607) is a genuine four-beat argument: the property-(P) assembly of the transformation, the reduction to filtration stages through exactness of filtered colimits, an induction on the filtration through the induced maps of short exact sequences coming from the split inclusions, and the final evaluation on the graded pieces as sums of shifts of A. H2: the induction structure is the content and no step is a bare citation.
